sql: CREATE TABLE edge_sq(id INT PRIMARY KEY,k INT)
SELECT id FROM edge_sq WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM edge_sq WHERE id=9) ORDER BY id
SELECT id,(SELECT k FROM edge_sq b WHERE b.id=a.id) AS k FROM edge_sq a ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM edge_sq a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edge_sq b WHERE b.id<a.id) ORDER BY id
